evidence.title: 水雲居 (poems of 1789 and 1794)
evidence.date: 乾隆五十四年 1789; 五十九年 1794
evidence.excerpt_zh: 御湖雖弗寛頗具滄波趣水雲本一家然各有時遇
evidence.summary: Two poems with this title, in runs on garden halls: 1789 between 養和室 and 耕雲堂, on the 御湖. S41 puts 水云居 on the island part of 濂溪乐处. So it is a name of late Qianlong at the latest, not a late dating clue.

evidence.title: 水云居
evidence.locator: v2 p.212, under 濂溪乐处; source ref 17-36
evidence.excerpt_zh: 御湖虽弗宽，颇具沧波趣。水云本一家，然各有时遇。春之水云艰，夏之水云屡。艰每愿其来，屡每愿其去。水云岂有意，而人殊好恶。好恶分公私，即公亦情附。谁能去安排，忘情任其素。
evidence.summary: Poem 水云居 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1789, filed by the editors under 濂溪乐处.

evidence.title: 水云居
evidence.locator: v2 p.213, under 濂溪乐处; source ref 18-716
evidence.excerpt_zh: 有本水原流止异，无心云或去来时。任其不竞及迟者，我岂能如杜老诗
evidence.summary: Poem 水云居 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1794, filed by the editors under 濂溪乐处.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v2, editors' note on 濂溪乐处
evidence.summary: An island residence with a nine-bay hall 慎修思永 and annexes of five, 芰荷深处, 香雪廊, 烟云舒卷 tower, 得月 and 临泉 pavilions, 水云居, 荷香书屋, 延云殿, seven-bay 知过堂 and 墨光亭. The editors say 慎修思永 and 知过堂 survived 1860 and were lost around 1900.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 水云居, 1x5 cells.
